fieldNotes.truckGate: Single private access driveway leaves Hwy 36 S, crosses a railroad spur, and runs ~350 m north into the plant — a clear single controlled approach / pinch-point. No barrier arm visible at the highway, but the long private drive functions as the controlled entry.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at the Hwy 36 entrance; trees and the rail crossing partly obscure the inner approach. Booth-style structure not confirmed in imagery, so guardShack=false / remoteGs=true (kiosk/call-box likely on a plant this size).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Private drive from highway to dock yard is ~350 m and can easily stack 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide drive apron at the highway and ample paved width on the internal approach.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive multi-row trailer drop lot along the west property edge — well over 50 trailer stalls.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spur runs along the south/southwest property edge and the access drive crosses it; a major plant of this scale is rail-served.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large multi-building manufacturing campus (process building, warehouses, ASF/associate service facility, fleet/maintenance buildings).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from the perimeter box (~95 acres including the drop lot and farmland buffer).
